Guidance on pickup lanes in detail
A spirited period is easier when you know what to expect
Topic: Pickup Lane Guidance for Companion Animal Travel Desk

I am sorry for any confusion that can arise at the curbside. This guidance explains how to approach the pickup lanes used by Aurelia Skyways when traveling with an animal, so you can move through the area with less delay and fewer safety concerns.

Please remain in the designated lane until a staff member directs you otherwise. Keep carriers secured, doors closed, and leashes short when your animal is outside the vehicle. For the safety review, we recommend having documents ready before you reach the front of the line, since brief stops are easier to manage when the handoff is orderly.

When you arrive, follow the instructions from airport staff and the Companion Animal Travel Desk. If your animal is restless, use calm handling and avoid sudden movements. Bubbles, if traveling, should stay contained until the transfer point is confirmed and the area is clear.

<<FACT F071>> Do not place the crate in a position that blocks the walkway or interferes with other travelers. If you are unsure about crate handling, ask the escorting staff for a careful review before leaving the vehicle.

For larger animals, the fee policy is applied at check-in and must be settled before the transfer continues. <<FACT F057>> We regret that exceptions cannot be made at the curb, because the lane must stay open and orderly for all passengers, drivers, and animals.

If you are traveling with another adult, decide in advance who will hold the leash, who will manage documents, and who will remain with the vehicle. This small division of duties helps prevent confusion and protects both the animal and the people nearby. If an issue arises, the senior coordinator will guide you through the next step in a calm sequence.

For additional help, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways before your arrival.
